content.title: XO, Kitty Season 3: Premiere Date, Cast, Latest News, and Everything Else to Know
content.text: It's time for senior year at KISS Senior year is starting for Kitty Song-Covey (Anna Cathcart), and she has one pressing to-do before graduation: Defining the relationship between her and Min Ho (Sang Heon Lee). About time! For XO, Kitty Season 3, fans are eagerly awaiting the two characters to become more than friends. Netflix renewed the To All The Boys spin-off series for a third season shortly after Season 2's premiere in January 2025. This was a relief given that Season 2 once again ended on a cliffhanger about Kitty and Min Ho. And if you don't remember what exactly happened between them — and to the many returning and new characters — we got a refresher below. Here's everything we know so far about XO, Kitty Season 3 including the premiere date and the cast. ALSO READ: XO, Kitty's Sang Heon Lee on how he 'lived life' before first major acting role, Minho and Kitty's relationship, and climbingXO, Kitty Season 3 latest newsNetflix has announced that To All The Boys' Lana Condor is reprising her role as Lara Jean, or LJ, in XO, Kitty Season 3. LJ makes an appearance in the trailer that Netflix released on March 9, which you can find below.XO, Kitty Season 3 release date Mark your calendars, because Netflix has announced when Kitty is heading back to the Korean Independent School of Seoul (KISS). XO, Kitty Season 3 premieres April 2. Netflix also revealed that the third season consists of eight episodes. XO, Kitty Season 3 trailers and teasersNetflix has unveiled the trailer for XO, Kitty Season 3, and it shows that Kitty is on a mission. She must define the relationship between her and Min Ho before senior year ends and it's too late. Thankfully, Kitty is getting some additional support this year: Lara Jean (Lana Condor) has booked a flight to visit her younger sister in Seoul. "Tell me everything," LJ says to a distressed Kitty. "After you take a shower." XO, Kitty Season 2 endingBy the end of XO, Kitty Season 2's finale, "Sealed With a Kiss," the major conflict is resolved. At the Moon's Young Talent showcase, Stella's (Audrey Huynh) plans for taking down the Moon family are thwarted. She was only getting close to Min Ho for the purpose of ruining his dad (Philippe Lee), who had humiliated her on national TV years ago. Needless to say, Min Ho and Stella's relationship ends after she's exposed. "I liked you, for real," Stella admits in their last exchange. "Only, I could tell your heart was never fully in it anyways." That sets the stage for a new beginning for Min Ho and Kitty. At this point, Kitty knows she has feelings for him and appears to be ready to confess in the final scene of XO, Kitty Season 2. But Min Ho tells her he's swearing off all relationships after being burned by Stella. "I think I was better off as a playboy," he says. That makes Kitty hesitate about confessing. Besides, Min Ho is about to leave KISS to join his brother Joon Ho (Peniel Shin) on his summer tour. "Maybe it's not our time. Not yet," Kitty's inner voice says in the finale's last moments. "Or maybe..." She stops Min Ho and asks to join on the summer tour. So, unlike the episode title suggests, their story was not "sealed with a kiss." But at least the Season 2 ending primes the audience for a full-on love story between Kitty and Min Ho in the next season. Anna Cathcart and Sang Heon Lee, XO, Kitty NetflixHere's the logline Netflix released about XO, Kitty Season 3: "Kitty Song Covey returns for her final year at KISS with her perfect senior year mapped out. She's going to make meaningful memories with her friends, grow closer to her relatives in Korea, and make big decisions about her future. And she's going to define her relationship with Min Ho. For real this time. But when surprise revelations throw her plans, and relationships, off course, Kitty will have to learn to embrace the unexpected."Where to watch Seasons 1 and 2 of XO, KittySeasons 1 and 2 of XO, Kitty are available to stream on Netflix.
